slides.say: A final grade counts the written exam twice as much as the oral exam. Sara scores sixty-one on the written exam and ninety-seven on the oral exam. What is her final grade?
So the two exams have different weights. It doesn't say weighted, but the written exam counts twice as much. So it's a weighted average.
We'll solve it in two different ways, the math way with the formula, and then by understanding, with the seesaw.
Let's start with the math way. Like in the lesson, the written exam counts twice, so we treat it as two copies. Sixty-one, sixty-one and ninety-seven.
Sixty-one times two is a hundred twenty-two. Plus ninety-seven is two hundred nineteen.
We divide by the sum of the weights, two plus one, three. Not by two.
Two hundred nineteen divided by three. Two hundred ten divided by three is seventy. And nine divided by three is three. So it's seventy-three.
at: Two hundred ten divided by three

slides.say: Careful with seventy-nine, choice number one. That's the plain middle of sixty-one and ninety-seven. It forgets the weights.
So her final grade is seventy-three. That's choice number four.
[pause] Now by understanding, with the seesaw. We start again from the givens. We draw a line, with sixty-one and ninety-seven above its ends.
The weights go below. The written exam, sixty-one, has weight two. The oral exam, ninety-seven, has weight one.
The weights are two to one, so the distances are one to two. We cut the gap into two plus one, three units.
The gap is ninety-seven minus sixty-one, thirty-six. Thirty-six divided by three is twelve. So each unit is twelve.
The heavy side gets the small part. So the average is one unit from sixty-one. Sixty-one plus twelve is seventy-three.
Let's check from the other side. That's two units from ninety-seven. Two times twelve is twenty-four. And ninety-seven minus twenty-four is seventy-three.
Careful with eighty-five, choice number three. That's one unit from ninety-seven, the light side. The small part goes to the heavy side.
Choice number four is our answer, and I'll see you in the next question.
at: Choice number four is our answer
